meta.title: API Balance Ring
meta.description: A real-time meter beside the composer's context ring. It detects which payment source you are actually on — a signed-in DSH account, a DeepSeek API key, or a third-party provider — and shows that balance, falling back to today's spend against a daily budget when the provider publishes no balance API. Priced per model at official CNY rates, macOS and Windows alike.
